changelog: Fixed: app restart after update no longer creates a duplicate process
Fixed: app logo now shows correctly across all screens (dashboard, AI prompt, AutoPilot panel)
Added: back button on AI prompt page to return to dashboard
Fixed: bandwidth limits no longer silently clobber each other when multiple devices are managed
Fixed: kernel network settings now properly restored when app stops
Fixed: app no longer freezes the UI when stopping network monitoring
Fixed: AutoPilot no longer shows upgrade popup on free plan startup
Fixed: memory leak in connection tracker for active devices
Fixed: iptables rules now cleaned up properly on stop
